name: Murad IV
role: Ottoman sultan (1623–1640), exercising personal rule from 1632
summary: Murad IV reasserted the sultan’s authority through coercion, personally enforced prohibitions, and led campaigns to recover Ottoman territory. His support for religious reformers accompanied severe restrictions on coffeehouses and tobacco.

sources.author: Ziya Yılmazer / TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
